## Summary

What changed and why, in two or three sentences.

## Test plan

How it was checked: tests added or run, pages opened, data sources exercised.

## Checklist

- [ ] `make test` passes
- [ ] `make lint` passes
- [ ] Docs updated where behavior changed (README, `docs/`, CHANGELOG)
- [ ] No secrets, account numbers or market data files in the diff
- [ ] Nothing places, cancels or changes orders
